name: Sellfluence Loop
author: sellfluenceloop

sections.description:
Sellfluence Loop is a platform where brands run affiliate campaigns with content creators. Creators share their own links, and every sale those links bring is attributed to them so the brand can pay a commission.

This plugin is the store side of that connection. It:

  • Records which creator link a visitor arrived from, in a first-party cookie that lasts 7 days.
  • Saves the creator’s referral code on any order placed within those 7 days.
  • Works with both the classic checkout and the block checkout, and with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Removes everything it created (its WooCommerce API key and webhooks) when you delete it.

You need a Sellfluence Loop brand account to use this plugin. Campaigns, creators, commissions and payouts are managed in the Sellfluence Loop panel.

External services

This plugin connects your store to Sellfluence Loop (https://sellfluenceloop.com), an affiliate platform for brands and content creators. It is needed to attribute orders to creators and calculate their commission.

The connection is created only when a store administrator starts it from the Sellfluence Loop panel and approves WooCommerce’s permission screen. Without that approval, the plugin sends nothing.

What is sent, and when:

  • Order webhooks (sent by WooCommerce, to api.sellfluenceloop.com): when an order is created or updated, WooCommerce sends the order to Sellfluence Loop. Sellfluence Loop stores only the order number, products, amounts, status and referral code. Customer names, contact details, addresses and payment details are not stored.
  • Plugin status (sent by the plugin, to api.sellfluenceloop.com): when the plugin is activated, deactivated or deleted on a connected store, it sends the store’s address, the event and the time, so that the panel can show the store’s status.
  • Disconnect request (sent by Sellfluence Loop, to your store): when you remove the connection in the panel, Sellfluence Loop calls the plugin’s signed endpoint to delete its API key from your store.

Sellfluence Loop terms of service: https://app.sellfluenceloop.com/terms
Sellfluence Loop privacy policy: https://app.sellfluenceloop.com/privacy

Privacy

The plugin sets one cookie, sf_ref, when a visitor arrives through a creator link. It holds only the creator’s referral code and the time of the click, and it expires after 7 days. A suggested text for your privacy policy is added under Settings → Privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New → search for “Sellfluence Loop”.
  2. Open the Sellfluence Loop panel and go to Settings → Integrations → WooCommerce.
  3. Enter your store address and approve the WooCommerce permission screen.

Until the store is connected, a notice in your WordPress admin reminds you to finish this step.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Sellfluence Loop account?

Yes. The plugin only tracks creator links; everything else happens in the Sellfluence Loop panel.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The connection stays in place and the Sellfluence Loop panel shows a warning. While the plugin is inactive, creator links are not tracked, so orders in that period are not attributed. Activating it again resumes tracking.

What happens if I delete the plugin?

The plugin deletes the WooCommerce API key and webhooks it created and tells Sellfluence Loop that the store is disconnected.

Does it slow down my store?

No. The plugin makes no outside requests while visitors browse or check out. It only adds a small script (about 2 KB) and a cookie.
sections.changelog:
0.6.0

  • Prepared for the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  • Updated the Sellfluence Loop service addresses.
  • Added a suggested privacy policy text.

0.5.0

  • Deactivating the plugin no longer disconnects the store; only deleting it does.
